'''Quinoa''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|quinoa flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[alcohol|quinoa beer]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] quinoa for its ''beer''.
